name: Painted Canvas
description: A mottled hand-painted backdrop on its stand, the studio showing itself.
lighting: One large soft key from the left, painterly falloff
subject: either
prompt: A hand-painted canvas backdrop mottled in storm grey, deep teal and umber hangs from a black background stand, its brushwork soft and cloudy, gravity pulling a few soft folds into its lower edge where it spills onto the floor. The stand's leg, the rolled top edge of the canvas and a strip of bare concrete floor beyond it are all in frame, the studio showing itself. One large soft key from the left gives the canvas a gentle glow that falls into shadow toward the right. The palette is storm grey, teal and umber, painterly, timeless and moody.
